def transform(grid):
    # Recover the regular triangular diagonal pattern. In each row, the value
    # baseline is the cyclic sequence represented by the non-erased cells;
    # zeros are masks over the relevant row/column template. The row template
    # has period 9 and is chosen by the most common phase among visible cells.

        phase=phases.most_common(1)[0][0]
